title: REFLEX on GEM-X v1
author: Neel Kaul
materials: Gently resuspend the pellet per recommendations below.
Invert tube 5X in order to mix.
Make Post-Hyb Resuspension Buffer B Mix:
Quickly centrifuge the Gel Beads, ~ 5 seconds
Wait 00:00:30 before continuing to the next step.
During the GEM incubation, pre-heat a thermocycler with "Fixed_GEM" program.
Retrieve GEMs from thermocycler. Add 125 µL of recovery agent to each sample.
Thaw Reducing Agent at Room temperature .
200 cycles. If sequencing GEX libraries alone: R
Make Quenching Buffer and keep on On ice

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions and Oligos
steps.instruction: Prepare necessary stock solutions and reconstitute lyophilized oligos.

substeps.instruction: Make stock 10X TBS solution (pH 7.4) and store at 4°C.
Centrifuge lyophilized RT probes and bridging oligos for at least 1 min at 15,000 x g.
Resuspend oligos in Molecular Grade Biology Water to 100 µM; keep at 4°C during work and store at -20°C.
Centrifuge lyophilized variable primers for at least 1 min at 15,000 x g and resuspend in Molecular Grade Biology Water at 100 µM.
Combine 5 µL of each variable primer to generate a 1.35 µM per primer pool (for TCR specific pool n=74, final volume is 370 µL).
Dilute the pool 1:1 with 370 µL of 1X TBS (final volume 740 µL, ~0.67 µM per primer).
Aliquot variable primer pools into 30 µL volumes and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Anneal RT Probes
steps.instruction: Anneal sample barcoded RT probes with matched bridging oligos.

substeps.instruction: Mix each alpha and beta RT probe separately with its matched bridging oligo (2 reactions per barcode).
Incubate at 95°C for 00:02:00, then ramp down to 4°C at 0.2°C/s.
Combine sample barcode matched, bridged TRAC and TRBC RT probes (30 µM each) at a 1:1 volume ratio for a final concentration of 15 µM.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up temperature-controlled equipment and pre-warm media.

substeps.instruction: Set cool centrifuge with swinging rotor buckets to 4°C.
Set water-bath to 37°C.
Pre-warm 40 mL of AIM-V media per cryopreserved PBMC vial (up to 100M cells/tube) to 37°C.
Set heat block or thermomixer to 25°C (RT) for fixation, and prepare separate settings at 42°C and 65°C for buffer/enhancer thawing.

steps.title: Thaw and Wash PBMCs
steps.instruction: Thaw cryopreserved cells and wash to remove cryoprotectants.

substeps.instruction: Thaw sample in 37°C water bath (~00:02:00) until ice barely melts.
Aspirate 1 mL sample from cryovial and add dropwise to 40 mL pre-warmed AIM-V in a 50mL conical tube, swirling gently.
Wash cryovial with 1 mL warmed AIM-V and return to the conical tube.
Invert tube 5x to mix.
If proceeding to live/dead counting or fixation, resuspend in 1 mL PBS (or PBS + 0.04% BSA if keeping on ice).
Spin at 400 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Add 24 mL PBS + 2% BSA and invert 5x.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL cold PBS + 2% BSA.
Spin at 400 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Fixation
steps.instruction: Count cells and perform fixation and quenching.

substeps.instruction: Count resuspended cells using preferred methodology.
Centrifuge samples at 400 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant (perform additional PBS wash if protein-rich media was used).
Resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL Fixation Buffer B mix; incubate for 01:00:00 at RT in a heat block.
Add 0.5 mL Additive C, mix 5x, and centrifuge at 850 x g, 20°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL chilled 4°C Quenching buffer B and maintain on ice.
Count fixed samples (27 µL PI dye + 27 µL cell suspension).

steps.title: Prepare Hybridization Reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw and prepare buffers and enhancers for hybridization.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Hyb Buffer B at 42°C; vortex and keep warm (do not place on ice).
Thaw Enhancer at 65°C for 00:10:00; vortex and keep warm (do not place on ice). If delay occurs, keep at 42°C for up to 10 mins; reheat to 65°C if precipitation occurs.
Prepare Hyb Mix at RT, mix 10x, and leave at 42°C for at least 5 minutes before use.
Thaw 10X WTA Probe Plate on ice; vortex and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Perform Probe Hybridization
steps.instruction: Hybridize probes to cells using a thermal cycler or thermomixer.

substeps.instruction: Set thermomixer (heated lid) or thermal cycler to 42°C (Lid: 42°C, Volume: 65 µL, Run time: 16-24 hours).
Aliquot quenched cells per barcode into strip tubes/PCR plate; spin at 850 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant (up to 15 µL may remain).
Add 5 µL of combined constant probes (single use, max 1 freeze/thaw).
Add 10 µL of unique Human WTA probes (PN-2001259-2001274).
Add 3.35 µL of pre-annealed/bridged REFLEX RT probe (matching WTA barcode).
Add 40 µL of pre-warmed Hyb Mix; mix 10-15x.
Seal tubes/plate and incubate at 42°C for 16 to 24 hours.

steps.title: Post-Hybridization Washing
steps.instruction: Wash cells to remove unbound probes.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Pre-Amp Primers B, TCR Variable Primer Mix, TruSeq-1 (1 µM), and Amp Mix C on ice.
Thaw Conc. Post-Hyb Buffer B (PN-2001308) at RT, then keep on ice; prepare Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B.
Add 225 µL Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B to each sample; mix 5x.
Count samples (44 µL PI dye + 11 µL cells).
Pool samples at 100,000 cells per barcode into a 15 mL conical tube; add 525 µL Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B per barcode.
Optional: Filter clumping samples using a 30 µm filter during pooling.
Spin at 850 x g, RT for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B; transfer to 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
Incubate at 42°C for 00:10:00; centrifuge at 850 x g, RT for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B; mix 5x; incubate at 42°C for 00:10:00; centrifuge at 850 x g, RT for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Centrifuge again at 850 x g, RT for 5 minutes.
Incubate at 42°C for 00:10:00; resuspend pellet in 0.5 mL Post-Hyb Wash Buffer B; mix 5x.
Remove 500 µL supernatant; resuspend pellet in 80 µL post-hyb resuspension buffer and transfer to 'ligation & RT' plate.
Rinse wash tube/plate with 40 µL and add to the plate (~130 µL total).
Centrifuge plate at 850 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove 115 µL supernatant (leave ~15 µL).
Add 35.83 µL Post Hyb Resuspension Buffer (final volume 50.83 µL); keep on ice.

steps.title: Ligation and Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform ligation and RT to generate cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 49.2 µL Ligation Master Mix to each well (final volume 100 µL); mix 10-15x.
Incubate at 25°C for 01:00:00 (Lid: 30°C).
Add 60 µL RT Reaction Mix (final volume 100 µL); mix 10-15x.
Incubate on thermocycler for 00:45:00 at 45°C (Lid: 45°C).
Remove 100 µL supernatant, leaving pellet in 10 µL buffer; add 30 µL Post-Hyb resuspension buffer (total 40 µL).
Centrifuge at 850 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove ~85 µL supernatant (leave 15 µL).
Resuspend in 95 µL chilled post hyb resuspension buffer (total 110 µL).
Centrifuge at 850 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Transfer entire volume to 1.5 mL tube; add 890 µL Post-Hyb Resuspension Buffer.
Centrifuge at 850 x g, 4°C for 5 minutes; remove supernatant.
Resuspend in 500 µL Post-Hyb Resuspension Buffer.
Filter each pool through a 30 µm filter into a new LoBind 1.5 mL tube.
Count pooled/filtered sample (12 µL PI dye + 12 µL cells).

steps.title: GEM Generation
steps.instruction: Encapsulate cells into GEMs using the Chromium X controller.

substeps.instruction: Assemble GEM-X Flex Gene Expression Chip and holder; avoid touching gasket.
Thaw Single Cell TL v1 Gel Beads (PN-2000538) for 00:30:00 at RT; vortex for 30s.
Thaw GEM Reagent Mix (PN2000491) at RT; vortex and centrifuge; keep on ice.
Prepare GEM Master Mix on ice; mix 15x and centrifuge.
In a strip tube on ice, combine cell pool + Post Hyb-Resuspension Buffer to 34.7 µL (max 20,000 cells/barcode, max 320,000 total).
Add 30.3 µL GEM Master Mix (total 65 µL).
Fill unused chip wells with 50% glycerol (1:1 glycerol w/MBGW).
Load Row 1: Dispense 60 µL Master Mix + Cell Suspension into wells without bubbles (mix 10-15x first).
Load Row 2: Dispense 60 µL Gel Beads into bottom center of wells without bubbles.
Load Row 3: Dispense 250 µL Partitioning Oil B (two 125 µL aliquots).
Close lid and run on Chromium X controller (~00:06:00).

steps.title: GEM Recovery and Pre-Amplification
steps.instruction: Recover GEMs and perform initial cDNA amplification.

substeps.instruction: Remove chip, tilt to 45°, and aspirate 100 µL GEMs from recovery wells into GEM plate on ice.
Load onto pre-heated thermal cycler with 'Fixed_GEM' program; seal and invert 10x (do not pipette).
Wait 00:02:00 for biphasic mixture (pink recovery agent bottom, clear aqueous top).
Spin down and remove 125 µL recovery agent (leave ~65 µL aqueous phase).
Incubate on thermal cycler as per program.
Spin down plate for 30 seconds; transfer 90 µL sample to 1.5 mL tube (avoid debris).
Add 1.8X volume SPRI beads (162 µL); incubate 00:05:00.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; discard 252 µL supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80% EtOH (wait 30s each); remove all EtOH.
Elute beads in 102 µL Elution Solution 1; wait 00:01:00, mix, and incubate 00:05:00.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; transfer 100 µL to new wells/plate.

steps.title: Sample Index PCR
steps.instruction: Perform indexing PCR on the pre-amp product.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL cleaned pre-amp product to a new plate on ice.
Add 60 µL Sample Index PCR mix and 20 µL index from Dual Index Plate TS Set A.
Seal, cool, invert/pipette 10x, and spin down.
Run on pre-warmed thermal cycler.
Spin down for 30 seconds; add 100 µL SPRI beads (1.0X); incubate 00:05:00 at RT.
Set on magnet until clear; discard ~200 µL supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80% EtOH (wait 30s each); remove all EtOH.
Resuspend beads in 42 µL Qiagen Elution Buffer (EB); incubate 00:02:00.
Set on magnet until clear; transfer 40 µL to new wells/plate.
Make 1:50 dilution (98 µL EB + 2 µL library) for storage/QC.

steps.title: TCR Re-Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform secondary PCR amplification for TCR libraries.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Kapa PCR Mix (ice), TruSeq2 (10 µM), and TruSeq1 (10 µM) (RT).
Split each pre-amp product into 4 separate reactions; prepare re-amp mixture.
Incubate as per specified protocol.
When sample reaches 4°C, spike in 0.5 µL TruSeq1 into each reaction; mix and spin down.
Incubate on thermal cycler as per specified protocol.
Spin down for 30 seconds; pool the 4 reactions per sample (~164 µL total).
Add 131.2 µL SPRI beads (0.8X); incubate 00:05:00.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; discard 295 µL supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80% EtOH (wait 30s each); remove all EtOH.
Elute in 52 µL Elution Solution 1; wait 00:01:00, mix, and incubate 00:05:00.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; collect 50 µL supernatant.

steps.title: TCR Indexing and Final QC
steps.instruction: Perform final indexing for TCR libraries and quantify.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Dual Index Plate TT Set A at RT, then keep on ice.
Add index to sample; seal, cool, mix 10-15x, and spin down.
Incubate on thermal cycler as per specified protocol.
Spin down for 30 seconds; add 70 µL SPRI beads (0.7X); incubate 5 minutes.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; discard 170 µL supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80% EtOH (wait 30s each); remove all EtOH.
Resuspend beads in 42 µL Qiagen Elution Buffer (EB); incubate 5 minutes.
Set on magnet for 2-3 mins; transfer 40 µL to new wells/plate.
Make 1:10 dilution (4 µL product + 36 µL EB).
Analyze GEX (1:50) and TCR (1:10) libraries on TapeStation HS D1000 (Expected: GEX 260 bp, TCR 460 bp).
Quantify using KAPA Library Quantification Kit: dilute 2 µL sample with water, add 16 µL Quantification Master Mix and 4 µL DNA standards, and run qPCR.
